messages:
Samir: hey folks — first week here. I accepted the GitHub invite but when I try to clone the platform repo I get a permission error, can someone point me?
Jamie: welcome Samir! are you using your work account or a personal one? sometimes SSO blocks clones if you haven’t granted access.
Samir: I clicked the invite link and logged in with my personal GH account that has my work email. org page shows me as an "outside collaborator" not a member.
Samir: ```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform.git
Cloning into 'platform'...
git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```
Sarah: hmm that looks like either SSH key not added or you haven’t granted SAML SSO access. two quick checks: (1) is your SSH key on your GH account? (2) on the org page, do you see a "Grant SSO access" button?
Samir: I do have an SSH key on my account. On the org page there’s a yellow banner: "Your organization requires SAML SSO. Authorize to access organization resources." but I don’t see the repo after authorizing, still outside collaborator.
Jamie: sounds like team membership didn’t get synced. @Sarah can you check team mapping for samir (GH username: samir-raj)?
Sarah: on it. Give me a sec to check the provisioning logs.
Sarah: ok I see the account — it was added as outside collaborator because the invite was accepted before the SCIM/team sync completed. I’m going to trigger a reprovision for SCIM and a team sync now.
Sarah: triggered reprovision. you should get a notification within a couple minutes from onboard-bot.
onboard-bot: Samir accepted SSO and was added to team "eng/devs" (write access) — membership updated at 2026-03-23T15:36:39Z
Samir: ran `ssh -T git@github.com` and got a welcome, trying clone again...
Samir: ```
$ ssh -T git@github.com
Hi samir-raj! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.
```
Samir: clone succeeded, can pull and push to a feature branch now. thanks! :tada:
Jamie: awesome — glad it’s sorted. quick note for future hires: accept the org invite from a browser, then go to the org page and click "Authorize SSO" before trying to clone. saves a roundtrip to ops.
Samir: noted, thanks everyone :)
